$comment: Cases both editors must judge alike, of the actions and options written in Kotlin; the format is that of kotlin.json. A Kotlin template or a %s of interpolate stands for a value the code computes: it is never judged as the text read in its place, and the rest of the expression is judged as ever.

cases.name: an Int template in an HTML string's action URL leaves its options judged
an Int template in a DSL call's action URL leaves its options judged
cases.source:
import io.github.markusaugust.streamlord.html.*
fun f(id: Int) = elements { div { dataOnClick("@get('/a/$id', {retyr: 'never'})") } }

fixes:
import io.github.markusaugust.streamlord.html.*
fun f(id: Int) = elements { div { dataOnClick("@get('/a/$id', {retry: 'never'})") } }

cases.name: an Int template in an attributes value leaves its options judged
cases.source:
import io.github.markusaugust.streamlord.html.*
fun f(id: Int) = elements { div { attributes["data-on:click"] = "@get('/a/$id', {retyr: 'never'})" } }

fixes:
import io.github.markusaugust.streamlord.html.*
fun f(id: Int) = elements { div { attributes["data-on:click"] = "@get('/a/$id', {retry: 'never'})" } }

cases.name: a %s in an interpolate format's action URL leaves its options judged
cases.source:
import io.github.markusaugust.streamlord.core.domain.interpolate
fun f(id: Int) = interpolate("<button data-on:click=\"@get('/a/%s', {retyr: 'never'})\">x</button>", id)

fixes:
import io.github.markusaugust.streamlord.core.domain.interpolate
fun f(id: Int) = interpolate("<button data-on:click=\"@get('/a/%s', {retry: 'never'})\">x</button>", id)

cases.name: a %s in an interpolate format leaves the other option values judged
cases.source:
import io.github.markusaugust.streamlord.core.domain.interpolate
fun f(id: Int, n: Int) = interpolate("<button data-on:click=\"@get('/a/%s', {retry: 'neverr', retryMaxCount: %s})\">x</button>", id, n)
